method: benchmarks/prefill_bench.py. cold = unique nonce first, so no prefix-cache hit; warm = identical prompt resent; TTFT measured with max_tokens=1 through the gateway. mixed = 8 streams decoding, then one cold ~32k prompt sent directly to :8006; 'stall' is the decoders' gap between streamed chunks while that prompt prefills (quiet-window p50 ~120-155 ms). Shared production server, light background traffic.

4096.note: warm turns reuse one 1,664-token cache block fewer than at 1024/2048
